meaning.content: A real browser-produced file was inspected with a semantic, operation-specific, or format-specific output invariant.
meaning.structure: Only parseability/filename/page count verified; does not satisfy primary internal certificate.
meaning.unit-only: Unit helper checks only; no real browser export proof.
meaning.PASS: A valid real-browser output satisfied a primary operation invariant on the tested synthetic fixture.
meaning.PASS_WITH_WARNING: A valid real-browser output satisfied a primary operation invariant, with known operation- or format-specific limitations.
